4-minutos.title: 4 MINUTOS
4-minutos.description: Final-year project: two kids from the neighbourhood hang out, smoke and talk nonsense until the conversation drifts somewhere bigger. In black and white, shot in long takes. Inspired by Sueños y pan.
process: The idea was to shoot the conversation in one go, leaving room for the silences and the shifts in tone between joking and something more serious. Halfway through the shoot the stabiliser ran out of battery and we had to improvise.
roles: Direction, script, camera and editing — Sofía Chernikova

credits.cast: Eneko Valle García · Fran Vidales Santos

tras-el-sofa.title: Tras el sofá
tras-el-sofa.description: Final-year project: six minutes of fiction shot on a studio set, in four hours, without leaving it. A girl kills her brother by accident and his girlfriend finds out.
process: With a crew of ten and a single space, everything depended on where the actors stood and on how the truth came out. There was no time for some shots, and continuity was solved in the edit.

credits.art: Ángela Barroso · Cristina García · María Rodríguez
credits.sound: Cristina García Jiménez · Sandra Alcaide Barrón

silver-praxis-condicion-perfecta.title: Silver Praxis — Condición Perfecta
silver-praxis-condicion-perfecta.description: Music video for Silver Praxis, from the underground rap scene: several locations and situations that follow the track with movement and a look tied to the artist's world.
process: Five days of shooting, shots inside a car and aerial footage from a drone I piloted myself. With no shot list, the edit came out of several hours of trying combinations until the rhythm of the track was there.

Profile.bio:
I say I tell stories. Sometimes with a camera, sometimes in writing, sometimes by talking to someone and asking questions. I studied Journalism and Audiovisual Communication because I've always found it hard to choose between looking and telling what I see. I suppose I'm still somewhere in between.

In front of a camera I don't much like performing, but I do like being there: improvising, reacting, getting it a bit wrong and carrying on. In an interview I try to listen more than wait for my turn to ask the next question. And then there's editing, which is another way of looking.

grupo-cadena-media.description: TV reporter at premieres, events and press conferences: I interview artists, actors and public figures and write the script for each piece.
bullets: Before each assignment, researching and deciding which questions make sense and what needs to be captured.
On site, gathering B-roll, securing interviews and presenting to camera, often improvising.
Interviews on variable time: two minutes at a photocall or a ten-minute conversation.

urjcmun.description: Since 2022 on the communications team of the Model United Nations at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos; in 2026, Deputy Director for Social Media.
bullets: Monthly content plan and Instagram feed design during the year leading up to the conference.
Selecting the team of reporters and delivering two training sessions.
During conference week, coordinating the reporters, working in pairs: assigning and reviewing coverage, interviews, photos and videos.

annie-bonnie.description: Internship at a communications consultancy, with Yoigo among the clients: a cross-cutting role between writing, video and analysis.
bullets: Writing articles for blogs and digital channels and taking part in editorial planning.
TikTok videos, from preparation to shooting and editing.
Interviews and event coverage, including MWC Madrid.
Weekly report on account performance, the best-performing content and the competition.

isocero.description: Photographer of family photo sessions at hotels, from the shoot to the sale.
bullets: Offering families a session by the pool and outdoors, and directing it in search of natural moments and poses.
Selecting and editing in Lightroom: light, colour and framing.
Presenting and selling the sessions at the stand, and delivering them following the hotel's procedure.
Responsible for the equipment and the till at the end of the day.

Contact.title: Shall we talk?
